info.title: nwcio
info.description: Command line tool that reads Autodesk Navisworks files (.nwc, .nwd, .nwf) without Navisworks and exports GLB, OBJ, or JSON.

options.name: --nwc
options.description: Save or convert to Autodesk Navisworks format (.nwc)

options.name: --ifc
options.description: Export 3D geometry, materials, and properties to IFC (IFC2x3 / IFC4)

options.name: --glb
options.description: Export 3D geometry and materials to glTF 2.0 Binary format (GLB)

options.name: --obj
options.description: Export 3D geometry to Wavefront OBJ format

options.name: --viewpoints
options.description: List saved viewpoints and cameras to standard output

options.name: --local-coords
options.description: Export geometry in local coordinate space (default: world coordinates)

options.name: --no-materials
options.description: Disable material and surface color extraction

options.name: --catalog
options.description: Include raw container stream catalog (offsets, sizes, kinds)

options.name: --no-transforms
options.description: Exclude 3D transform matrices from JSON export

options.name: --no-tree
options.description: Exclude hierarchical scene graph tree from JSON export

options.name: --no-indent
options.description: Write compact JSON instead of pretty-printed indented JSON

options.name: --bvh-stats
options.description: Include Bounding Volume Hierarchy (BVH) spatial index statistics

options.name: --clashes
options.description: Run cross-model clash detection for multi-model assemblies

options.name: --report
options.description: Print summary report to standard error

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this help message and exit

options.name: --version
options.description:
Show version information and exit
Exit codes:
0  Success
1  Usage error (missing or invalid arguments)
2  File or folder not found
3  Data format error or parsing failure

arguments.name: INPUT
arguments.description: Path to .nwc, .nwd, .nwf file or a folder of .nwc models.

arguments.name: OUTPUT
arguments.description:
Destination path for exported file (.json, .obj, .glb, .ifc, .bcfzip, .html, or .nwc).
Default: <input-without-ext>.json (or standard output if '-').
